site.title: SaaS Fabric
site.subtitle: Static-first app factory by Inkognitroz.
site.heroTitle: Build, Launch & Monetize Your SaaS Products
site.heroDescription: SaaS Fabric is an open-source, static-first platform for building mini-apps, capturing ideas, tracking your roadmap and preparing to monetize — all without a backend.
site.promptWorkflow: Store prompts in Prompt Inbox, then paste into GitHub Issues, Copilot, Codex, Claude Code, or ChatGPT to request pull requests. Review manually and merge safely.

about.title: About SaaS Fabric
about.description: SaaS Fabric is a static-first, open-source app factory built by Inkognitroz. The goal is a practical, non-technical workflow for building and launching SaaS products without infrastructure overhead.
